title: Keep reviewing after the course
intro: Your course is closed. If you like, you can keep short review checks going on what you learned, spaced out over the coming weeks.
terms.optional: It is optional. Nothing changes unless you choose it.
terms.noRequiredWork: Nothing is required: no new lessons, deadlines or assignments.
terms.noCredit: Reviews do not add new credit or change your course record.
terms.staysClosed: The course stays closed exactly as it was recorded.
terms.stopAnytime: You can stop at any time.
consent: I understand, and I want to keep reviewing after the course.
active: You are reviewing after the course (since {date}).
activeExplain: Review checks will be ready when they are due. They are optional and do not change your course record.
objectiveFallback: A learning objective from this course
error.CONTINUATION_ALREADY_ACTIVE: You are already reviewing after the course.
error.CONTINUATION_NOT_ACTIVE: Reviewing after the course is already stopped.
error.ENROLLMENT_NOT_CLOSED: This is available once the course has closed.
error.CONTINUATION_NOT_OPTED_IN: Start reviewing after the course first, then try again.
error.CONTINUATION_NO_REQUIRED_WORK: After the course, only review checks are available. New lessons and assignments are not.
error.STALE_REVISION: Your course changed in another window. The latest state is shown; try again.
error.generic: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
